name: Software delivery Outcome pack
evidenceCharacter: template / editorial synthesis with DORA metric names
purpose: Suggested measurement pack for software-delivery initiatives, including AI-assisted delivery. It does not prove AI caused a change; it defines a useful set of outcome measures and leading indicators to inspect.
aiSpecificLeadingIndicators: share of changes materially touched by AI-assisted tooling
review wait time for AI-touched changes
revert or rollback rate for AI-touched changes

recommendedRecordFields.outcomeMeasure: Track the five DORA software-delivery metrics for the selected application/service. Add AI-touched share, review wait, and revert/rollback rate as leading indicators when AI-assisted delivery is the intervention being assessed.
recommendedRecordFields.baseline: Use a comparable pre-intervention period with the same metric definitions and service boundary.
recommendedRecordFields.fullRelevantCostBoundary: Include model/tool licences or inference, review and correction, CI/test infrastructure, deployment/operations, support, and material incident/rework cost relevant to the decision.
recommendedRecordFields.nextEvidence: Collect the same measures after the agreed observation window and name material confounds such as staffing, release policy, architecture, workload mix, or major platform changes.

qualification: DORA metrics describe software delivery performance for an application or service. They do not by themselves establish customer value, AI ROI, causal attribution, or total business profitability.
